Qais Ahmad to Najmul Hossain Shanto, out Bowled!! Knocked him over! That's a terrific delivery from Qais to get rid of the well-set Shanto. Qais gives this one more air and floats it well outside off. Shanto reaches out and tries to drive through covers but the ball turns in sharply. It goes through the bat-pad gap and crashes into middle and leg. Shanto is standing there with a bemused look on his face. That turned a mile. A really good knock from Shanto comes to an end. Hasan Mahmud tried to keep it out but got beaten on the outside edge to get rapped in front. Hasan Mahmud took the review. Time for the replays. UltraEdge shows a flat line. Over to ball-tracking and it returns three reds - it would have hit the top of middle and off. Hasan Mahmud lbw b Zia-ur-Rehman 1(6)
